finalists.label: Hepatic Artery Thrombosis
finalists.why: The 2.8-cm filling defect in the common hepatic artery is a specific finding that strongly supports this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Hepatic Artery Disease
finalists.why: The 2.8-cm filling defect in the common hepatic artery is a specific finding that supports this diagnosis, and it is a more general category that includes thrombosis.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a 2.8-cm filling defect in the common hepatic artery, which is a specific finding for thrombosis, decided the final comparison in favor of Hepatic Artery Thrombosis over the more general category of Hepatic Artery Disease.
